entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to make a return? I'm a bit confused about how it all works.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, it's Sarah Gable. The order number is... um... VF78-221-B. It's for the cycling shoes.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the VeloFit Pace cycling shoes, delivered 33 days ago. To get started, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I'm not sure... I just... they're not right. I wore them once, and the positioning for the cleats felt strange, and I got these horrible blisters. The website was so complicated, I didn't know what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. I'm sorry to hear they caused blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check our return eligibility for you.
Okay, I've pulled up the policy. It looks like you're well within the return window. VeloFit has a 90-day return period for standard items like these shoes.
Oh, really? So I can still return them even though I wore them and it's been over a month?

Absolutely. Since you're within the 90 days, I can process this for you right now. I can issue a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried I was stuck with them.

You're very welcome, Sarah. The email with the label is on its way. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
